requirements.summary: Use DeepSeek Harness as the software-delivery orchestration runtime.
Enable an agent to ingest evidence, implement from specifications, verify, and deliver software.
Use OpenAI models through DeepSeek Harness and price OpenAI usage.
Track and map model cost to every repository change.
Keep the complete delivery engine in a separate project directory on the main branch.
Reuse one engine to develop multiple independently specified projects such as catalog consolidation.
Validate agent output, preserve traceability, and enforce offline release gates.
